description: Cas d'usage 2 : Passages à niveau SNCFT is a data set listed in Tunisian transport sector open data portal (data.transport.tn), a sector open data portal, published or maintained by Les Cas d'usages. LA modélisation d'un système de Passages à Niveaux à travers les données Open Data permettrait l'identification des points noirs, un meilleur calcul des risques, la prévention des accidents à travers des applications mises à la disposition des du citoyen. Coverage: Tunisia. The portal files it under the publisher Les Cas d'usages. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-01-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OTL (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tunisia-transport-open-data-portal.
